messages:
maria (Marketing): Heads up — planning to publish the release post next Wed 9am PT. Need final changelog and docs links by EOD Tue. Also webinar slot needs confirmation. @ajay @ken @tess
ajay (Eng): We can freeze changelog by Tue noon. Still finishing perf numbers for embedding benchmark. Expect final numbers by Mon EOD.
ken (Docs): Docs can push links once changelog is in branch docs/release-1.2. Will open PR for review. link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234
tess (Product): Product thumbs up on messaging. Webinar: can we do Wed 11am PT? Marketing wanted same-day post + webinar. Is that ok infra-wise?
maria (Marketing): Prefer 9am post, webinar 11am sounds good. Need a 30m pre-brief for speakers at 10:20. @release-bot can you schedule canary rollout at +2 hours after post? :eyes:
release-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary rollout window set to 11:00-13:00 PT. Notified eng-oncall.
ajay (Eng): Canary at +2h is tight for some customers. Recommend staggered rollout: 10% at +2h, 50% at +6h, 100% at +24h. Will add fallback to previous model.
maria (Marketing): Staggered rollout works. Marketing to prepare messaging for potential rollback. Also need benchmark narrative (short blurb + chart). @ajay can you provide a 1-sentence summary and perf CSV?
ajay (Eng): I can do 1-sentence + attach CSV by Tue noon. CSV: s3://redwood-bench/embeddings/1.2.0/summary.csv
ken (Docs): Docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234 — includes changelog draft and example API snippets. Need tech review from @ajay.
ajay (Eng): Reviewing now. Quick note: API snippet requires header example update (x-rw-model-version).
tess (Product): Inbound lead routing — marketing wants a webhook to push registrants to SFDC via Zapier. @ken can docs include webhook example?
ken (Docs): Yep will add a short 'webhook payload' section under integrations.
maria (Marketing): Great. Action items: ajay -> perf CSV + 1-sentence (due Tue noon). ken -> PR with webhook payload + final docs link (due Tue EOD). tess -> confirm webinar speakers and prep pre-brief (due Tue EOD). I'll draft release post and share Monday for feedback.
ajay (Eng): :thumbsup: set. Also flagging ENG-4321 for canary automation.
maria (Marketing): Thanks — I’ll slot a 20-min check-in Monday 9am PT to review assets. Calendar invite incoming.
